_source: 05 L31-96 (command table), 05 L98-102 (query/write split), 05 L119 (doctor --ack/--unack are writes)
_conventions: name = sub-command as typed without the `rl` prefix; kind = write | query | admin; who = who-can-call column of 05, gyb exempt from who except where noted; ledger = which ledger the command writes or mainly reads (null for cross-ledger queries).

commands.name: init
commands.who: gyb, bare terminal only; refused with exit 3 inside a role session
notes: Rerun has no side effects: existing things untouched, missing ones added, prints two columns 'existed, skipped' / 'created' (08 L11; sync-inbox Q39(b)).
Asks gyb the repo-bound config keys one by one; does not touch host code or the repo's .claude/ (08 L13, L36).
The read:notes question is gone with the grant mechanism (sync-inbox Q43(a) L312; 08 L36).

commands.name: session start
commands.signature: rl session start --role R [--model M] [--launched-by manual|subagent|workflow]
notes: rules_version is read by rl from the first line of common/GLOBAL-RULES.md (05 L40; sync-inbox Q37(g)).

commands.name: session amend
commands.who: gyb or that role's own live session

commands.name: inbox
commands.who: anyone; roles call it when they need it, not on start; run does not use it

commands.name: decision retire
commands.pending: PENDING(issue 37a): the reason flag name --text is the hub's analogy with update; gyb reviews it at the final merge.

commands.name: decision merge
commands.signature: rl decision merge ID1 ID2 ... --text --root ID [--source ...]

commands.name: issue open
commands.signature: rl issue open --to R --kind K [--stage S] --text [--handoff ID] [--log-tail FILE|--log-text -]
notes: --to gyb no longer triggers a desktop notification; the issue shows in rl status section 2 (sync-inbox Q40(d) L287).

commands.name: issue reply
commands.who: per role ledger_writes; only the assignee or gyb (03 L92)

commands.name: issue close
commands.who: per role ledger_writes; only the opening actor or gyb, plus the assignee for notification kinds (03 L92)

commands.name: handoff open
commands.who: owner; quick-lane supplement: deploy calls it, owner recorded as gyb
commands.signature: rl handoff open --type T --to R [--parent ID] [--decision ID@V ...] [--explain ...] [--eval ID@V ...] [--track T] [--command ... --workdir ... --config k=v ...] [--batch B] [--manual|--no-dispatch] [--quick-lane --report-method P --ql QL --code-path P ...]
notes: --track: a work_order takes the direction name; a launch_order copies it from the parent into attempts[0].track, so the launch-order-side flag may be omitted (sync-inbox Q45(c)(f)).

commands.name: handoff start
notes: With --batch B the ID only locates the batch (ID must belong to B, otherwise exit 5) and every todo launch_order whose batch is B is started at once: one start version per order, holder = this session; session end hands the whole batch back (04 L98, L122; proxy decision D-22). Without --batch only ID is started.
How host and gpus are split inside a batch is not ruled: PENDING(part 21 L181).

commands.name: handoff amend
commands.signature: rl handoff amend ID [--command ... --workdir ... --track ... --config ...] [--report-method P --report-detail P --code-path P ...] [--notebook P --figure P ...] [--decision ID@V ...] [--eval ID@V ...]
notes: On a launch_order, amend without --command appends one more attempt copying the previous attempt's command, workdir, track and config, run_id <ho-id>-a<attempt> (principle 10: one run is one attempt; proxy decision D-31).

commands.name: handoff resume
commands.who: per transition table (role that answered the issue, owner)

commands.name: handoff done
commands.signature: rl handoff done ID [--report-method P --report-detail P --code-path P ...] [--notebook P --figure P ...]
notes: The deliverable paths may be given on done itself (work_order: --report-method, --report-detail, --code-path; analysis_order: --notebook, --figure); they are written into the done version and checked for existence per 04 L68; no new transition row, in_progress still takes no amend (proxy decision D-32; flag names per 05 L199).

commands.name: handoff accept
commands.who: per transition table (owner; quick-lane supplement only gyb)

commands.name: handoff release
commands.who: per transition table (session-end hook, reclaim, owner)
notes: --note is required for in_progress->todo, not for rejected->todo (05 L65; 04 L39).

commands.name: handoff estimate
commands.signature: rl handoff estimate ID --step NAME --kind gpu|cpu --smoke-seconds S --scale F | rl handoff estimate ID --copy-from ID2 [--scale F]

commands.name: handoff list
commands.signature: rl handoff list [--status S] [--owner R] [--holder SESSION] [--to R] [--batch B] [--decision ID] [--line L]

commands.name: run add
notes: command, config and run_id are copied from the launch order; started_at is filled by rl (05 L73).

commands.name: run finish
commands.signature: rl run finish RUN_ID --exit ok|failed|killed [--metric k=v ...] [--data-path P]
notes: Computes actual_seconds from the two timestamps, copies it into the launch order's latest attempt, runs the anomaly check in-process, and calls the host finish command template (05 L73; 04 L43; 08 L74-75).

commands.name: run list
commands.signature: rl run list [--handoff ID] [--decision ID] [--batch B] [--line L] [--all]

commands.name: feedback accept
notes: Checks every applied_to path exists, bumps rules_version and writes it back to the first line of common/GLOBAL-RULES.md, lists live sessions with their rules_version, prints the to-do (05 L80; 09 L59).

commands.name: eval propose
commands.signature: rl eval propose --kind metric|figure --name ... --definition ... [--metrics-key K | --code-path P] [--group-by ... --x ... --y ... --uses ID ...] --applies-to ...

commands.name: eval update
notes: An approved evaluation that is updated goes back to proposed (03 L156).

commands.name: ql open
notes: Assigns ql_tag inside the lock, creates the worktree (deploy) or analysis/scratch/<ql_tag>/ (analysis), writes the scratch open row (07 L25-29).
--from marks a todo work order quick_lane and takes it out of the todo queue without a holder (07 L31; sync-inbox Q41(f)).

commands.name: ql close
notes: Both paths delete the worktree and the branch of the same name (07 L92; sync-inbox Q41(f)).
--merged requires ID to be a quick_lane supplement whose ql_tag equals QL (05 L87).

commands.name: reclaim
commands.signature: rl reclaim [--session-older-than H] [--handoff-older-than H] [--only ID ...] [--skip ID ...] [--kill] [--apply]
notes: Without --apply it only lists (a query in effect); with --apply it writes with actor gyb and via=reclaim (04 L176-184).

commands.name: doctor
commands.who: anyone; roles look only, fixes go to the owner or gyb

pending_commands.name: grant add
pending_commands.signature: rl grant add --to R --permission P --text ... [--expires ...] [--issue ID]
pending_commands.pending: PENDING(issue 43c): grants ledger kept as a name only, no commands (D-01)

pending_commands.name: <quick-lane exit of a transferred order>
pending_commands.pending: PENDING(issue 41f): the sub-command that appends the exit version (direct to done_pending_review, or back to todo unmarking quick_lane) for an order transferred by `ql open --from` has no name yet (07 L114).

removed_commands.name: notify
removed_commands.why: Desktop notifications are not built in this version; rl status is the only outlet (01 L137-141; sync-inbox Q40(a) L286).
